ac.item: Root cause identified and stated (not just made green).
ac.evidence: Local Postgres server TimeZone = America/Chicago (source='configuration file'); no 'timezone' key on any connection in config/database.php, so PostgresConnector never issues SET TIME ZONE and every PDO session inherits it; Eloquent writes naive 'Y-m-d H:i:s' literals; Postgres resolves a naive literal against the SESSION zone when storing into timestamptz; platform.kit_shifts.started_at/ended_at are timestamptz. Driver probe through the real app: wrote 2026-09-14T12:00:00+00:00, read back '2026-09-14 12:00:00-05', delta 18000s; a naive `timestamp` column in the same probe had delta 0. CI passes because its Postgres is stock postgis/postgis:16-3.5 (UTC). The ticket's own stated hypothesis (User::timezone) was falsified by three independent passes, and DEV-2467's 'local ClickHouse container artifacts' call was right in instinct but wrong in subsystem.

ac.item: The three tests pass both in isolation and in a full-suite run.
ac.evidence: ISOLATION, final code, real ClickHouse: CloseInactiveShiftsCommandTest 14 passed (52 assertions); EnsureOpenShiftTest 11 passed (16); PostgresConnectionTimezoneTest 2 passed (5). A/B control WITHOUT the fix reproduces the ticket exactly: CloseInactiveShiftsCommandTest 2 failed (deltas 3600 and 18000), EnsureOpenShiftTest 1 failed. FULL SUITE, final code: 2009 passed / 8 failed / 428s, with all three target files passing. The 8 failures are pre-existing local flakiness driven by the ClickHouse container's 5.21 GiB ceiling - proven by a failing-SET diff (identical sets with and without the fix, zero tests unique to either) and a 4x4 single-test probe on the only candidate, which passed 4/4 WITH the fix and 3/4 without. NOTE the ticket's 'full-suite only' premise is wrong: these fail in isolation too, as DEV-2309's PR #309 note had recorded.

ac.item: If the bug is in the command rather than the test, that fix ships too - a 5-hour window error in shift closing would be a real production bug.
ac.evidence: The bug is in neither the command nor the test. CloseInactiveShiftsCommand and EnsureOpenShift are both correct - every ->utc() is ->copy()->utc(), every Carbon::parse passes an explicit 'UTC', and the diffInMinutes calls are abs()-guarded. The defect is that the application never pins the Postgres session timezone, which is configuration. The operator scoped this ticket to test-only (twice, on two distinct variants, the second a verified production no-op), so no production fix ships. OPEN RISK, recorded not resolved: production's TimeZone GUC was never checked. If it is not UTC, 10 timestamptz columns across kit_shifts, scout_check_ins, org_run_areas and scout_org_settings are being stored shifted in production.
